content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Lincoln

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a four-year degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high-school diploma plus five years. Document your hours, roles, and project outcomes. Granite PM Academy's advisors review eligibility questions at no cost before enrollment.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Formal Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Bootcamp, delivered by active certified practitioners. Attend instructor-led sessions on your schedule, participate in real-time Q&A, and receive course materials immediately. All training happens online—no travel required.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application and Fee
steps_items.text: Once you finish the bootcamp, formally apply to PMI with your eligibility documentation and project details. Pay the associated exam fee directly to PMI. Our team guides you through the online application process step by step.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor office hours—to build confidence. Schedule your proctored exam through PMI's testing partner. You'll take it remotely at a time that fits your work and personal life.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential Over Three Years
steps_items.text: Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) throughout the standard three-year renewal cycle by attending training, publishing, volunteering, or delivering project work. Renew your PMP before expiration. Granite PM Academy offers continuing-education courses to support your ongoing compliance and career growth.
